items.question: What happened to Brex?
items.answer: Brex was a corporate card and financial management platform for startups, valued at $12.3B at its 2022 peak. After the fintech correction compressed valuations, Capital One agreed to acquire the company for $5.15B in January 2026 (closed April 2026). Brex's CEO Pedro Franceschi remains leading the business under Capital One.
items.title: Brex Pre-IPO & Private Investment Profile | WealthUnion

items.question: What lessons does the Brex acquisition teach private investors?
items.answer: Entry price matters enormously. Investors at the $12.3B 2022 peak lost ~58% in the acquisition. Investors at the $1-3B 2019-2020 levels made strong returns. The Brex story illustrates both the upside potential of early private investing and the re-pricing risk of buying late-stage at peak multiples.
